content:
Generate a cinematic storyboard sheet with 8 storyboard panels and production-notes sections (timecode, shot/action/camera, audio/SFX, VO, character profile, negative prompts) in GPT Image 2, then use it as the visual plan/reference for Seedance 2.0 shots.

Prompt Seedance scenes as a shot list with explicit camera framing and movement per beat (e.g., extreme aerial wide, wide back shot with slow approach, medium profile close-up, macro insert with bokeh, silhouette framing, epic final wide) to control pacing and composition.

Lock a consistent film look by specifying a director/style reference plus camera and lighting details in the prompt (e.g., Zhang Yimou visual poetry, Wong Kar-wai melancholy, ARRI ALEXA LF, soft overcast morning light, thin mountain fog, atmospheric haze, shallow depth of field, muted natural palette, photorealistic 8K).

Use environment and mood constraints (endless purple wisteria hills, foggy morning, drifting valley mist, silence/no combat/no villains) to keep Seedance outputs focused on emotional storytelling rather than action.
